problem: Isotonic regression calibration dropped AUROC from 0.9345 to 0.8457 — impossible for a correct monotonic transform. Root cause: isotonic step function fit on only 112 train-fraud rows produced coarse plateaus, collapsing distinct raw scores into tied calibrated values.
fix: Replaced isotonic regression with Platt scaling (logistic regression on the single ensemble-score feature). Strictly monotonic by construction, so AUROC is mathematically guaranteed to be preserved after calibration.
